attributes.name: [Chargeback] Data trust & deployment harvest health issue

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost, chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution METADATA _index
| EVAL threshold_unallocated_spend = 100.0, threshold_unallocated_pct = 25.0, unallocated_currency = "", currency_unallocated_thresholds = ""
| EVAL is_bill_doc = (_index LIKE "*billing_cluster_cost*"), is_usage_doc = (_index LIKE "*cluster_deployment_contribution*")
| EVAL bill_ts = CASE(is_bill_doc, @timestamp, null), usage_ts = CASE(is_usage_doc, @timestamp, null)
| INLINE STATS latest_bill_day = MAX(bill_ts), latest_usage_day = MAX(usage_ts), total_bill_rows = COUNT(CASE(is_bill_doc, 1, null))
| EVAL expected_latest_day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, NOW() - 6 hours) - 1 day
| EVAL is_billing_stale = CASE(latest_bill_day IS NULL OR latest_bill_day < expected_latest_day, 1, 0)
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND deployment_id IS NOT NULL AND (is_bill_doc OR is_usage_doc)
| EVAL target_day = CASE(is_billing_stale == 1, COALESCE(latest_usage_day, latest_bill_day, expected_latest_day), COALESCE(latest_bill_day, latest_usage_day, expected_latest_day))
| EVAL is_target_bill = (is_bill_doc AND @timestamp == target_day), is_target_usage = (is_usage_doc AND @timestamp == target_day)
| WHERE is_target_bill OR is_target_usage
| EVAL ts = @timestamp, ck = composite_key::keyword, b_dep_id = deployment_id,
       bill_clean_dname = CASE(is_target_bill AND deployment_name IS NOT NULL AND deployment_name != "" AND deployment_name != deployment_id, deployment_name, null),
       usage_clean_dname = CASE(is_target_usage AND deployment_name IS NOT NULL AND deployment_name != "" AND deployment_name != deployment_id, deployment_name, null),
       fallback_dname = CASE(deployment_name IS NOT NULL AND deployment_name != "", deployment_name, null)
| EVAL has_usage = CASE(is_target_usage, 1, 0)
| INLINE STATS dep_has_usage = MAX(has_usage), dep_u_dname = MAX(usage_clean_dname), dep_fb_dname = MAX(fallback_dname), dep_target_bill_rows = COUNT(CASE(is_target_bill, 1, null)) BY target_day, b_dep_id
| WHERE is_target_bill OR dep_target_bill_rows == 0
| DROP composite_key
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_currency_symbol
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL _c_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null),
       _c_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0, TRIM(cloud_sym), null),
       _o_has_row = (conf_chargeable_unit_rate IS NOT NULL),
       _o_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)), null),
       _o_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_currency_symbol)) > 0, TRIM(conf_currency_symbol), null)
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)),
       unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, CASE(_o_has_row, COALESCE(_o_unit, _c_unit, "EUR"), "EUR"), COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR"))
| EVAL _def_sym = CASE(unit == "USD", "$", unit == "GBP", "£", unit == "ZAR", "R", "€")
| EVAL currency_symbol = CASE(
    is_onprem_row,
    CASE(_o_sym IS NOT NULL, _o_sym, _o_has_row AND _o_unit IS NULL AND _c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _c_sym IS NOT NULL AND _c_unit == unit, _c_sym, _def_sym),
    CASE(_c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _def_sym)
  )
| EVAL units = CASE(is_target_bill, COALESCE(total_chargeable_units, 0.0), 0.0)
| EVAL cost = units * rate
| EVAL alloc_cost = CASE(is_target_bill AND COALESCE(is_allocatable, false) == true, cost, 0.0)
| EVAL unalloc_cost = CASE(is_target_bill AND COALESCE(cost_category, "other") == "other" AND COALESCE(sku, "none") != "none", cost, 0.0)
| EVAL day = LEFT(TO_STRING(target_day), 10),
       latest_bill_day_val = latest_bill_day
| STATS
    b_dname = MAX(bill_clean_dname),
    u_dname = MAX(dep_u_dname),
    fb_dname = MAX(dep_fb_dname),
    has_usage_any = MAX(dep_has_usage),
    billing_stale = MAX(is_billing_stale),
    bill_rows_cnt = MAX(total_bill_rows),
    latest_bill_m = MAX(latest_bill_day_val),
    dep_units = ROUND(SUM(units), 2),
    dep_spend = ROUND(SUM(cost), 2),
    alloc_spend = ROUND(SUM(alloc_cost), 2),
    unallocated_spend = ROUND(SUM(unalloc_cost), 2),
    sym = COALESCE(MAX(currency_symbol), "€"),
    thresh_unalloc = MAX(threshold_unallocated_spend),
    thresh_pct = MAX(threshold_unallocated_pct),
    cfg_unalloc_curr = MAX(unallocated_currency),
    cfg_curr_unallocs = MAX(currency_unallocated_thresholds)
  BY day, b_dep_id, unit
| RENAME b_dep_id AS deployment_id
| INLINE STATS org_spend = SUM(dep_spend) BY day, unit
| EVAL _cu_entries = MV_APPEND(SPLIT(REPLACE(TO_UPPER(COALESCE(cfg_curr_unallocs, "")), " ", ""), ","), "_FALLBACK_:0")
| MV_EXPAND _cu_entries
| DISSECT _cu_entries "%{_cu_u}:%{_cu_v}"
| EVAL _matched_unalloc = CASE(_cu_u == unit, TO_DOUBLE(_cu_v), null)
| STATS
    b_dname = MAX(b_dname),
    u_dname = MAX(u_dname),
    fb_dname = MAX(fb_dname),
    has_usage_any = MAX(has_usage_any),
    billing_stale = MAX(billing_stale),
    bill_rows_cnt = MAX(bill_rows_cnt),
    latest_bill_m = MAX(latest_bill_m),
    dep_units = MAX(dep_units),
    dep_spend = MAX(dep_spend),
    alloc_spend = MAX(alloc_spend),
    unallocated_spend = MAX(unallocated_spend),
    org_spend = MAX(org_spend),
    sym = MAX(sym),
    explicit_unalloc = MAX(_matched_unalloc),
    thresh_unalloc = MAX(thresh_unalloc),
    thresh_pct = MAX(thresh_pct),
    cfg_unalloc_curr = MAX(cfg_unalloc_curr)
  BY day, deployment_id, unit
| EVAL norm_ucurr = TO_UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cfg_unalloc_curr, "")))
| EVAL eff_thresh_unalloc = COALESCE(explicit_unalloc, CASE(norm_ucurr == "" OR norm_ucurr == unit, COALESCE(thresh_unalloc, 100.0), null)),
       thresh_pct = COALESCE(thresh_pct, 25.0),
       raw_dname = COALESCE(b_dname, u_dname),
       deployment = COALESCE(raw_dname, fb_dname, deployment_id)
| EVAL unallocated_pct = CASE(org_spend > 0.0, ROUND(unallocated_spend * 100.0 / org_spend, 1), 0.0)
| EVAL is_synthetic_bucket = (STARTS_WITH(deployment_id, "deleted_or_unassociated") OR (STARTS_WITH(deployment_id, "unassociated_") OR deployment_id == "unassociated") OR deployment_id == "organization")
| EVAL has_usage_issue = (NOT is_synthetic_bucket AND alloc_spend > 0.0 AND has_usage_any == 0)
| EVAL has_missing_name = (NOT is_synthetic_bucket AND dep_units > 0.0 AND (raw_dname IS NULL OR raw_dname == "" OR raw_dname == deployment_id))
| EVAL has_unalloc_issue = (eff_thresh_unalloc IS NOT NULL AND unallocated_spend > eff_thresh_unalloc AND unallocated_pct > thresh_pct)
| EVAL has_any_issue = (has_usage_issue OR has_missing_name OR has_unalloc_issue)
| EVAL issue_type = CASE(
    has_usage_issue, "missing_usage_harvest",
    has_missing_name, "missing_deployment_name",
    "high_unallocated_spend"
  )
| EVAL result = CONCAT("[", day, "] Deployment `", deployment, "` (", deployment_id, ") issue=", issue_type, ": daily_spend=", sym, TO_STRING(dep_spend), " ", unit, ", has_usage=", TO_STRING(has_usage_any), ", unallocated=", sym, TO_STRING(unallocated_spend), " ", unit, " (", TO_STRING(unallocated_pct), "% of org spend).")
| EVAL issue_entry = CASE(has_any_issue, CONCAT(day, "\t", deployment, "\t", deployment_id, "\t", issue_type, "\t", TO_STRING(dep_spend), "\t", TO_STRING(unallocated_spend), "\t", TO_STRING(unallocated_pct), "\t", unit, "\t", result), null)
| STATS dep_rows = COUNT(*), any_billing_stale = MAX(billing_stale), bill_rows_max = MAX(bill_rows_cnt), latest_bill_str = COALESCE(LEFT(TO_STRING(MAX(latest_bill_m)), 10), "none"), unit_cnt = COUNT_DISTINCT(unit), single_unit = MAX(unit), issue_entries = VALUES(issue_entry)
| EVAL out_unit = CASE(dep_rows == 0, "EUR", unit_cnt == 1, COALESCE(single_unit, "EUR"), "MULTI")
| EVAL expected_day_str = LEFT(TO_STRING(DATE_TRUNC(1 day, NOW() - 6 hours) - 1 day), 10)
| EVAL outage_entry = CASE(dep_rows == 0 OR COALESCE(any_billing_stale, 1) == 1 OR COALESCE(bill_rows_max, 0) == 0, CONCAT(expected_day_str, "\torganization\torganization\tstale_billing_data\t0.0\t0.0\t0.0\t", out_unit, "\t[", expected_day_str, "] Deployment `organization` (organization) issue=stale_billing_data: latest_billing_day=", COALESCE(latest_bill_str, "none"), ", expected_day=", expected_day_str, ", billing_rows=", TO_STRING(COALESCE(bill_rows_max, 0)), "."), null)
| EVAL active_entry = COALESCE(MV_APPEND(issue_entries, outage_entry), issue_entries, outage_entry)
| WHERE active_entry IS NOT NULL
| MV_EXPAND active_entry
| DISSECT active_entry "%{day}\t%{deployment}\t%{deployment_id}\t%{issue_type}\t%{dep_spend_str}\t%{unallocated_spend_str}\t%{unallocated_pct_str}\t%{unit}\t%{result}"
| EVAL dep_spend = TO_DOUBLE(dep_spend_str), unallocated_spend = TO_DOUBLE(unallocated_spend_str), unallocated_pct = TO_DOUBLE(unallocated_pct_str)
| KEEP result, day, deployment, deployment_id, issue_type, dep_spend, unallocated_spend, unallocated_pct, unit
